## Decision / evidence
- The dossiers have no binary `approved`/`not approved` field. `productionEligible: true` is a separate production-readiness certification that triggers stricter validation (screenshot SHA-256 digests + `compositionTopology.basis === "curated-screenshots"`), which all 35 archive dossiers **lack**. Forcing it `true` made `loadReferenceDossier` throw for all 35 (invalid, not usable). Per user decision, only `review.status` was flipped to `"reviewed"`; `productionEligible` stays `false`.
- Rights/licensing **provenance text was not altered** — compliance records preserved verbatim, including statements such as "no source-owner grant was attached" and "not an independently audited asset-by-asset license".
